The sole command revokes, by the words of the order, all Executive orders or parts thereof establishing airspace reservations within the continental limits of the United States except the District of Columbia, and the order does not apply to Alaska or the Panama Canal Zone. The command operated when the order issued on December 6, 1941 and was thereby exhausted; its result, the revocation, survives as an accrued effect. EO 10768 of May 16, 1958 recites that EO 7138 was revoked as to its other airspace reservations by this order, which shows the revocation took effect, but it does not revoke or amend this order and is a later event, not an end. The order states no effective date other than its date; filing in the Federal Register was December 9, 1941.
